draft.text: You came in because you have had lower back pain and tingling for four months after an injury while helping your son move.
We did not find any new symptoms or changes in your pain pattern during this visit.
Your pain may be related to your past injury and could be from muscles, discs, or other structures in your lower back.
We will talk about getting an MRI to look more closely at your back.
We will also discuss avoiding heavy lifting and long periods of sitting to help with your symptoms.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have had lower back pain since helping your son move four months ago.
You have a dull ache in your lower back that sometimes becomes sharp when you turn a certain way or roll over in your sleep.
The pain gets worse when you lift heavy things or sit for a long time, but feels better when you stretch or change positions.
You will have an MRI to check for possible disc or muscle issues.
You will also see a physical therapist to help with your back pain.
